catatan: POV fisheye bergaya Roblox: lift hotel Blocky Inn berhenti di lantai 13 yang tidak ada. Fiksi orisinal, bahasa Inggris USA.

baris.text: Now arriving at floor thirteen. Please step out.
baris.arah: (calm polite automated elevator announcement, slow and flat, slightly too cheerful)

baris.text: Wait... this hotel doesn't have a thirteenth floor.

baris.text: Why are you standing in the dark?
The lights broke! Just let me in!

baris.text: Why are they all facing the wall...
